target_concept: Recognize that Git is a distributed version control system used to track project changes

mcq.questionText: Which of the following statements correctly explains why Git being a distributed version control system is useful?
options: Each developer has a full copy of the repository, allowing them to track changes locally without relying on a central server.
All changes must be stored on a single central server, so developers cannot work offline.
Git only records changes to binary files, ignoring source code modifications.
Git automatically resolves all merge conflicts without any user intervention.
mcq.correctAnswer: Each developer has a full copy of the repository, allowing them to track changes locally without relying on a central server.
mcq.explanation: The evidence states that Git is a distributed version control system that helps developers keep track of changes. In a distributed system, each developer maintains a complete repository copy, enabling local tracking and offline work, which is the key benefit described.
